003_p: Leave the ordinary. Go somewhere that doesn't exist. Come back with your own shape.
006_p: A two-day residential expedition for young people into an imaginary land — where the usual rules about who you are don't apply.
007_p: Games, drawing, movement, storytelling, role-play. Not a curriculum: a place to set daily pressure down and look honestly at yourself, with people doing the same thing beside you.
009_p: Notice your shadow — and discover that its shape can change through what you do.
010_p: Young people are asked constantly what they will become, and rarely given room to ask what is actually in the way. Jungle Jam makes that room, and then makes the answer something you can act on — one small, specific act, named out loud before you leave.

041_p: Length, language, group size, and the balance of drawing, movement, and conversation are set with you beforehand — two residential days, one long day, or a series of afternoons. Tell us who is coming and what they are carrying, and we build the version that fits.
